channel.description: Latest articles from The Colorado Sun (coloradosun.com)

item.title: ICE is violating court order against warrantless arrests in Colorado, lawyers say
item.description: Lawyers representing immigrants are asking a federal judge to intervene — again

item.title: Colorado Democrats propose new limits on 3-D printed guns, tougher rules for firearms dealers
item.description: Federal data show ghost guns are increasingly turning up at crime scenes

item.title: “What’d I Miss?”: Teens on an icy mission to Minnesota
item.description: In "What'd I Miss?" Myra offers a definition of "Christian heroes" in Minneapolis that her friend considers going against the grain.

item.title: Drew Litton: Lindsey Vonn, Olympic profile in courage
item.description: Cartoonist Drew Litton salutes the determination of Colorado's superstar ski racer Lindsey Vonn, who despite an injury is strapping on the boards for the Olympics.

item.title: Have Denver’s Flock cameras been used for immigration enforcement?
item.description: Yes. Police nationwide accessed information from Denver's Flock surveillance cameras for immigration-related searches in 2024 and 2025.

item.title: Resort industry insiders who organized to help Nederland buy Eldora are no longer part of the plan
item.description: The Nederland Board of Trustees in the last month have approved a $120 million purchase of Eldora ski area as well as the issuance of as much as $225 million in revenue bonds. The 303 Ski group that formed to help the deal is not playing a role.

item.title: Voters thought Colorado wasn’t doing enough to protect its water even before this winter’s dry spell
item.description: When it comes to water issues in Colorado, the public’s anxiety is high — especially because snowpack levels aren’t. Voters share their thoughts on what needs to be done.

item.title: “My child’s life is expendable”: Fight for gender-affirming care and risk of federal defunding plays out in a Denver courtroom
item.description: Families of transgender kids are suing Children’s Hospital Colorado, saying that the hospital’s decision to suspend gender-affirming care for minors violates a state anti-discrimination law

item.title: Trump’s freeze of $10B in funds for low-income families in Colorado, 4 other states blocked by federal judge
item.description: $300 million will continue to flow to Colorado's child care and safety net programs, per a preliminary injunction issued Friday

item.title: Colorado man who abused nearly 200 corpses gets 40 years in prison, families call him a “monster”
item.description: Jon Hallford apologized before his sentencing and said he would regret his actions for the rest of his life
